$comment: Where each MIDI key note goes (#380), pinned for all three ports:
MIDIKeyParser.route(forNote:adapterSendsRawPaddles:) in ios/Sources/MorseKit/MIDIKeyMessage.swift
and VailKeyerMode.sendsRawPaddles in ios/Sources/MorseKit/VailKeyerMode.swift;
MidiKeyParser.routeForNote in android/.../morsekit/MidiKeyMessage.kt and the desktop copy, and
AdapterKeyer.sendsRawPaddles in android/.../AdapterKeyer.kt and the desktop copy.
Read by ios/Sources/MorseKitCheck/main.swift and MidiKeyRoutingFixtureTest.kt (android, desktop).
'held': the note holds the one logical key down for as long as it is held, as before #380.
'keyerDit' / 'keyerDah': the note is a raw paddle contact and goes into the app's own paddle
keyer (PaddleKeyer, the on-screen paddles' keyer), at the Settings paddle mode and speed.
'passthrough' is the route with the app's adapter Keyer mode set to Passthrough; 'otherModes'
is the route with it set to any other mode (Straight Key, Bug, ... Keyahead).
Sources, not captured from either port. Vail Adapter firmware (Vail-CW/vail-adapter):
in Passthrough (Program Change 0, no keyer object) adapter.cpp sends the paddle contacts raw
on notes 1 (dit) and 2 (dah), in every firmware. In the keyer modes, firmware up to v4.3
(keyers.cpp StraightKeyer::Tx calls output->BeginTx()) sends every timed element on note 0;
from v4.4 (commit 5448935, 2025-09-23, 'Fix iambic keyer left/right control bug') through
v5.1.0 and master (2026-11) StraightKeyer::Tx calls output->BeginTx(relay), and
VailAdapter::BeginTx(int relay) sends each keyer-timed dit element on note 1 and each dah
element on note 2 (docs/MIDI_INTEGRATION_SPEC.md still says note 0). So notes 1 and 2 are raw
only in Passthrough, and in every other mode they stay held keys, exactly as before #380.
Note 0 is the straight key input (and every element of the pre-4.4 keyer modes): always held.
N6ARA TinyMIDI (the Vail web client's inputs.mjs treats 20/21 as raw paddles) and the
Morserino-32 Pocket ('USB Output = MIDI', oe1wkl/Morserino-32 PR #224: raw dit 20, dah 21 in
its paddle keyer modes, note 30 for the straight key in Straight Key mode) have no keyer mode
the app sets, so 20/21 are raw whatever the adapter Keyer mode is, and 30 is always held.
61/62 carry the dit/dah contacts of fixtures/midi-key-notes.json (no device source found) and
are routed with 20/21. 'rawPaddleModes' lists the adapter keyer modes (fixtures/keyer-modes.json
names) in which the adapter sends raw contacts on 1/2.
A note changing route is a behaviour change: say so in the commit. Do not regenerate to make
a failing test pass.
